    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frais_annexes (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      classe_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),
      label TEXT NOT NULL,
      montant REAL NOT NULL,
      obligatoire INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      annee_scolaire TEXT NOT NULL,
      annee_scolaire_id TEXT REFERENCES annees_scolaires(id)
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS paiements (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      frais_annexe_id TEXT REFERENCES frais_annexes(id),
      tranche_numero INTEGER,
      montant REAL NOT NULL,
      date_paiement TEXT DEFAULT (date('now')),
      mode_paiement TEXT CHECK (mode_paiement IN ('especes','orange_money','mtn_momo','virement')),
      recu_numero TEXT UNIQUE,
      enregistre_par TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS matieres (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      classe_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),
      nom TEXT NOT NULL,
      nom_en TEXT,
      coefficient REAL DEFAULT 1,
      section TEXT CHECK (section IN ('francophone','anglophone','maternelle')),
      enseignant_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id)
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      matiere_id TEXT REFERENCES matieres(id),
      periode TEXT NOT NULL,
      note REAL CHECK (note >= 0 AND note <= 100),
      appreciation TEXT,
      saisie_par TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS competences_maternelle (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      periode TEXT NOT NULL,
      domaine TEXT NOT NULL,
      competence TEXT NOT NULL,
      statut TEXT CHECK (statut IN ('acquis','en_cours','non_acquis')),
      observation TEXT,
      saisie_par TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS presences (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      date TEXT DEFAULT (date('now')),
      statut TEXT CHECK (statut IN ('present','absent','retard','excuse')),
      note TEXT,
      alerte_envoyee INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS personnel (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      nom TEXT NOT NULL,
      prenom TEXT,
      telephone TEXT,
      email TEXT,
      type TEXT CHECK (type IN ('enseignant','administratif','assistant_maternelle','securite','entretien','chauffeur')),
      contrat TEXT CHECK (contrat IN ('cdi','cdd','vacataire','benevole')),
      date_embauche TEXT,
      salaire REAL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academic_histories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      classe_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),
      annee TEXT NOT NULL,
      statut TEXT CHECK (statut IN ('admis','redoublant')),
      moyenne REAL,
      rang INTEGER,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS liste_attente (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      classe_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),
      eleve_id TEXT REFERENCES eleves(id),
      position INTEGER,
      date_ajout TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      statut TEXT DEFAULT 'en_attente' CHECK (statut IN ('en_attente','admis','annule'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annonces (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
      ecole_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      titre TEXT NOT NULL,
      contenu TEXT NOT NULL,
      cible TEXT DEFAULT 'tous' CHECK (cible IN ('tous','personnel','parents','enseignants')),
      priorite TEXT DEFAULT 'normale' CHECK (priorite IN ('normale','importante','urgente')),
      auteur_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
      date_publication TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      date_expiration TEXT,
      is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parametres_maternelle (
      ecole_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ecoles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      valeur TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_annonces_ecole ON annonces(ecole_id, is_active);

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { requireSuperAdmin } from '../../../../lib/auth'
import { getDb } from '../../../../lib/db-server'
import { PLAN_PRICES, type LicencePlan } from '../../../../lib/licence'

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!await requireSuperAdmin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acc├¿s refus├⌐' }, { status: 403 })
  }

  const db = getDb()
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]

  const totalEcoles = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ecoles').get() as { count: number })?.count ?? 0
  const totalEleves = (db.prepare(
    'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM eleves WHERE statut = ?'
  ).get('actif') as { count: number })?.count ?? 0

  const licencesActives = (db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM licences
    WHERE is_active = 1 AND date_fin >= date('now')
  `).get() as { count: number })?.count ?? 0

  const licencesExpirant = (db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM licences
    WHERE is_active = 1 AND date_fin >= date('now')
    AND date_fin <= date('now', '+30 days')
  `).get() as { count: number })?.count ?? 0

  const licencesExpirees = (db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM licences
    WHERE is_active = 1 AND date_fin < date('now')
  `).get() as { count: number })?.count ?? 0

  const licencesParPlan = db.prepare(`
    SELECT type, COUNT(*) as count FROM licences
    WHERE is_active = 1 AND date_fin >= date('now')
    GROUP BY type
  `).all() as { type: LicencePlan; count: number }[]

  let chiffreAffaires = 0
  for (const row of licencesParPlan) {
    chiffreAffaires += (PLAN_PRICES[row.type] || 0) * row.count
  }

  const renouvellements30j = db.prepare(`
    SELECT l.*, e.nom as ecole_nom, e.slug as ecole_slug
    FROM licences l
    JOIN ecoles e ON e.id = l.ecole_id
    WHERE l.is_active = 1
    AND l.date_fin >= date('now')
    AND l.date_fin <= date('now', '+30 days')
    ORDER BY l.date_fin ASC
  `).all()

  const nouvellesEcolesMois = (db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ecoles
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now')
  `).get() as { count: number })?.count ?? 0

  const tauxConversion = totalEcoles > 0
    ? Math.round((licencesActives / totalEcoles) * 100)
    : 0

  const ecoles = db.prepare(`
    SELECT e.*,
      l.type as licence_type,
      l.date_fin as licence_fin,
      l.is_active as licence_active,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eleves el WHERE el.ecole_id = e.id AND el.statut = 'actif') as nb_eleves
    FROM ecoles e
    LEFT JOIN licences l ON l.ecole_id = e.id AND l.is_active = 1
    ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
  `).all()

  return NextResponse.json({
    stats: {
      totalEcoles,
      totalEleves,
      licencesActives,
      licencesExpirant,
      licencesExpirees,
      chiffreAffaires,
      nouvellesEcolesMois,
      tauxConversion,
    },
    business: {
      plans: licencesParPlan.map(p => ({
        plan: p.type,
        count: p.count,
        revenu: (PLAN_PRICES[p.type] || 0) * p.count,
      })),
      renouvellements30j,
    },
    ecoles,
  })
}
